snippet.title: SIGILLUM - Second Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Finally! After months of hard work at the studio, we are incredibly excited to share a new look at what we’ve been working on.

SIGILLUM is a first-person survival horror experience inspired by the history and culture of Southern Spain. We’ve poured our hearts into creating an immersive atmosphere that pays homage to the nostalgic, retro aesthetic of the PS1 era, featuring environments meticulously recreated at a 1:1 scale.

This is just a glimpse of what’s to come. We hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoy creating it!

Support us by adding SIGILLUM to your Steam Wishlist:
Help us out and stay updated on our progress by adding the game to your wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3565390/SIGILLUM/

We are very active on our social channels! Follow us to get the latest dev updates, behind-the-scenes content, and to connect with the team. We’d love to see you there:

Website: https://www.closed-room-studio.com

X/Twitter: https://x.com/ClosedRoomGames

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/closedroomstudio

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@ClosedRoomStudio

#SIGILLUM #IndieGame #SurvivalHorror #IndieDev #PS1Aesthetic #MadeInSpain #RetroGaming #HorrorCommunity
